University Library & Information Services - Benguet State University Toggle Accessibility Statement Home Skip to Main Content Sitemap This website adopts the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.0) as the accessibility standard for all its related web development and services. WCAG 2.0 is also an international standard, ISO 40500. This certifies it as a stable and referenceable technical standard. 

WCAG 2.0 contains 12 guidelines organized under 4 principles: Perceivable, Operable, Understandable, and Robust (POUR for short). There are testable success criteria for each guideline. Compliance to these criteria is measured in three levels: A, AA, or AAA. A guide to understanding and implementing Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0 is available at: https://www.w3.org/TR/UNDERSTANDING-WCAG20/

Accessibility Features

Shortcut Keys Combination Activation Combination keys used for each browser.

	Chrome for Linux press (Alt+Shift+shortcut_key) 
	Chrome for Windows press (Alt+shortcut_key) 
	For Firefox press (Alt+Shift+shortcut_key) 
	For Internet Explorer press (Alt+Shift+shortcut_key) then press (enter)
	On Mac OS press (Ctrl+Opt+shortcut_key)

	Accessibility Statement (Combination + 0): Statement page that will show the available accessibility keys. 
	Home Page (Combination + H): Accessibility key for redirecting to homepage. 
	Main Content (Combination + R): Shortcut for viewing the content section of the current page. 
	FAQ (Combination + Q): Shortcut for FAQ page. 
	Contact (Combination + C): Shortcut for contact page or form inquiries. 
	Feedback (Combination + K): Shortcut for feedback page. 
	Site Map (Combination + M): Shortcut for site map (footer agency) section of the page. 
	Search (Combination + S): Shortcut for search page.

Email: ulis@bsu.edu.ph Mobile No.: (063) 949.477.0460 Mobile No.: (063) 966.624.2314 VISION: A premier university library delivering world-class library services MISSION: To provide quality services and resources in line with the university’s mission LIBRARY GOALS and OBJECTIVES 1. To develop pre-emptive programs to ensure relevant quality library resources Objectives: a. Documentation, preservation, and provision of access of the indigenous knowledge of the university for current and future generations b. Avenue for quality selection and acquisition of resources c. Widen availability of university’s scholarly communication through advocacy and support for open access publishing 2. To develop proactive programs for quality service Objectives: a. Benchmark and continuous adaptation to current library services that is compliant to national and international best practices b. Develop and implement innovative promotion of information literacy programs c. Enhance and develop staff welfare programs d. Develop edutainment experiences and spaces to match up-to-date needs of the users. 3. To initiate collaborative, gender sensitive research and extension library programs for institutional and sustainable community development Objectives: a. Develop, produce, and disseminate relevant knowledge to stakeholders b. Enhance departmental partnership to boost the BLIS/MLIS program c. Expand partnership with local, regional, national and international entities for resource sharing Library Hours: Mondays-Fridays: 7:30 AM – 6:00 PM (Philippine Standard Time) Saturdays: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM (Philippine Standard Time) Sundays & Holidays: Closed • No lunch break • During Semestral, Christmas, Summer breaks – no face-to-face services • Library patrons can direct message our Facebook page 24 /7 for any library-related queries Unit Libraries College of Nursing Library (3rd flr CN bldg) – This unit library contains books on the major field/subject on Nursing. College of Veterinary Medicine Library (3rd flr CVM bldg) – This unit library contains books/references on the major field/subject on Veterinary Medicine. Library Requirements For Students: 1. All library patrons must register at the Circulation Desk by filling out a form and presenting a validated university ID Card. 2. Returning students should update their records every first week of each semester at the Circulation Desk Section. For Visitors/Outside Researchers: 1. Submit a communication letter (via snail mail or email) for group benchmarking or tours. 2. Present a referral letter of any valid identification card for walk-in access. An online public access catalog (OPAC or simply library catalog) is an online database of materials held by a library or group of libraries. Users search a library catalog principally to locate books and other materials available at a library. In simple language it is an electronic version of the card catalog. OPAC is the gateway to library's collection Office of the President Benguet State University 2nd Floor-Admin Building, Km. 5, La Trinidad, Benguet 2601 Philippines web.admin@bsu.edu.ph Official Social Media Accounts Facebook YouTube Instagram Twitter
